# Claude Cowork Alternatives — full text

Source: https://claudecoworkalternative.com/

Claude Cowork is Anthropic's closed desktop AI agent: closed source, Anthropic-only models, no self-host, paid. This site compares the whole field of alternatives, open and closed.

## Comparison (licence | where it runs | models | isolation)
- OpenWork | MIT | local desktop (macOS/Windows/Linux) | 50+ via BYOK | local process. Built on OpenCode; most visible open-source Cowork.
- OpenHands | MIT | Docker / your infra | any LLM backend | container per task.
- Kortix/Suna | Elastic 2.0 (source-available) | your cloud/VPC/on-prem or managed | any provider, your keys | disposable sandbox per session; review-gated merges. Org-scale agent-management system; agents/skills/memory as git files.
- Kuse | open source (Rust) | local desktop | multi-provider | local process.
- Open Cowork | MIT | Windows/macOS desktop | Claude/GPT/Gemini/DeepSeek/local via BYOK | VM-level sandbox.
- Cursor | closed | cloud + desktop | multi-model hosted | vendor-managed. Coding-first.
- ChatGPT agent | closed | OpenAI cloud | OpenAI models | vendor-managed.
- Perplexity Computer | closed | Perplexity cloud | Perplexity models | vendor-managed. Autonomous, usage-priced.
- Claude Cowork (baseline) | closed | Anthropic cloud + desktop | Anthropic only | folder-scoped permissions.

## Decision rule
If your blocker is licensing, model lock-in or data residency, filter to open-source and source-available rows. If it is capability today and you accept cloud-only, a closed agent is fine.

## Self-hosting
Desktop (OpenWork/Open Cowork): install locally, BYOK. Server-side (OpenHands/Kortix-Suna): run where the data lives; keep keys in a secret store; prefer per-session isolation and human review before changes land.

Related: https://opensourceclaudecowork.com
